as_told.title: Lost envelope found stuck to the back of a book by Brent's daughter

plain: A man named Brent Friedman says that a stranger once gave him and his colleague Bryce Zabel a written formula in an envelope, that they lost it for years, and that it turned up again around 2023 or 2024 when his daughter found it in his garage in Washington. Friedman tells it as his own story: the paper had slipped out of its envelope, got damp, and "stuck to the back of a book" because of the glue. He says he was researching that formula, the thing "the guy gave us," which makes it a document he believes is worth decoding.
